cases.title: Migrate existing saves without entering Stage C
assertions: Load the frozen completed v5 endpoint and the conservative and purchased completed v6 endpoints in separate temporary browser contexts.
Wait for native save/lock completion; verify schema/content7, unchanged board IDs, old source cursors, balances, purchases, held promises, earlier ending and chapter-entry versions.
Reload each twice. Assert no Stage C entry, no unlocked new source, no new material, and collection availability stays at the already entered160/200/240 scope.

Before migrating one purchased v6 fixture, open its frozen v6 writer. After v7 migration, attempt one old-tab action and assert newer bytes are protected and the old tab falls back to isolated practice.

cases.title: Explicit third-boundary entry and concurrent-tab protection
assertions: Start from the purchased v6 endpoint with retained old tile stock, desk promise and partial old sorter cursor. Open and cancel the new continuation twice; reload and compare saved bytes.

Open two same-context tabs at the same revision. Submit one third-boundary command from each through the real UI/native session gate; exactly one entry/revision is committed and the other becomes stale.
Verify old resources/promises remain; version7 receipt and entry, only Crab newly unlocked, exactly two selected sources, zero Snail stock, intended new Undo boundary; reject stale/repeated entry.

cases.title: Play all nineteen new letters and four two-letter gates
assertions: Use the conservative8980-XP endpoint with no Stage C stock. Chromium uses authored order; WebKit reverses every legal opener/fork ordering. No purchase or optional order is completed.
Make/deliver each requested piece through visible controls and verify exact consumption, reward increment, one durable save and letter milestone.

At all four chapter entries focus the exact zero-reward story (Knight letter2, others letter1). For these four captures set BOTH profiles to390x664, assert visible0 XP/0 coins on card, compact strip and accessibility label plus both-opening-letter notice, then restore the profile default viewport.
Before the second opening letter, assert the second family remains locked. After both, assert free source unlock with zero gifted material and exactly two source controls.
Finish at19 new milestones,395 added XP/175 coins, no purchase/repeat delivery, level54 and9375 XP. Preserve all previous endings and stop at the280 checkpoint.

cases.title: Reject XP substitutes, wrong tier and wrong quantity
assertions: Use a reducer-generated pre-second-opener fixture with XP above the chapter threshold earned by documented optional deliveries; do not invent XP or unlock fields.
Verify Snail remains locked and chapter continuation unavailable until the exact pending second story is sent.

In a separate exact-delivery fixture, show that a higher-tier Crab cannot enable Send for Crab1. Use the reviewed source-bound test probe for two intentionally invalid completion commands (wrong tier; two IDs for quantity1), since the normal UI does not offer a malformed tile-ID selector. Verify no payout, consumption, order change or durable write.
Send exactly one valid tile and verify its identical retained sibling remains.

cases.title: Preserve held letters, callback sources and resumed work
assertions: Use real pre-callback states for Trowel/Fern and Cogwheel/Key, including one old held optional promise and old source cursor.
Choose callback; assert its exact source pair. Resume the held optional, reload, switch once to another held optional, and return to the same suspended story without new order IDs or rewards.
Manually select a different unlocked pair, reload twice and verify it is preserved until deliberate refocus. Refocus callback and send it from exact retained/fresh material.
For the final Next Move letter, verify the return to Knight/Cogwheel without losing the old Key stock/cursor.

cases.title: Navigate the expanded collection without save writes
assertions: Use the previously reducer-generated completed280 fixture with all forty new pictures discovered by documented zero-reward makes.

Visit all fourteen20-picture pages and verify exactly280 unique catalog IDs. Verify DOM image bytes on discovered cards; undiscovered old cards must stay masked rather than inventing old discoveries. The160/40/40/40 volume scopes must retain exact identities and counts.
For the four new chapters select chapter then each of its two families; assert10/5 picture filters, deterministic reset/page clamping and valid next/back controls.
Record each scope/page DOM list and source/build binding; view-only navigation must not write the career save. Capture first/last all-volume pages.

cases.title: Retain four endings and isolate historical/new replay
assertions: View the original, Stage A, Stage B and Stage C terminal endings from the completed fixture; record exact copy and no automatic next-chapter entry.
Replay short-measure-letter-6 at content5, paper-duet-letter-6 at content6, and next-move-letter-5 at content7 through visible controls.
Assert pinned recipes and zero career reward, and compare persistent career bytes before/after each replay and return.
Stage C says280 on the way to320; no further unwritten continuation or claimed320 completion.

cases.title: Inspect eleven exact postcards and download real PNGs
assertions: From documented discovery fixtures, open and download the eight new tier5 cards: Crab, Snail, WateringCan, Trowel, Flatiron, Mitten, ChessKnight and Cogwheel.
Also open/download WateringCan1,2,3 to cover all four selected framing windows together with Flatiron5.

Verify exact name/chapter, decoded source identity, ready image dimensions, actual downloaded1536x1120 PNG and suggested filename moticos-<lowercase-piece-name-with-spaces-replaced-by-hyphens>.png, plus original-renderer/cache parity. c280-*.png names are normalized evidence filenames only. Decode every download; valid PNG alone is not composition acceptance.
For every tier5, its own postscript appears only after its own discovery. No companion discovery, reward, material consumption or chapter-completion prerequisite may be inferred.
Final human/independent visual review must inspect all22 actual exports across both engines, including full composition, white margins, material texture and preserved openings.

cases.title: Measure occupied phone layouts and long completion labels
assertions: Use a valid pre-final-letter state with all eight new sources earned. Prepare exactly20 occupied cells through recorded reducer actions: eight new tier3 tiles, b1/b2/f1/f2/k1/k2/m1/m2, and four additional b1 tiles. Check320x568,390x664,390x844,430x932 in normal/large text: eight bounded layouts per profile.

For each layout inspect actual25-cell geometry, visible art/ink, full compact labels, all required HUD glyph rectangles, wallet, Orders/More, tools and two visible next-output source previews. Preserve the accepted minimums and real overflow/overlap assertions; do not waive failures by hiding/truncating labels.
Repeat320x568 in normal/large text at the Stage C terminal heading for two additional long-label layouts. Check focused0-XP strip where applicable.

Save exactly ten named routine screenshots per profile. Both browser engines use this mobile-size matrix even though Chromium default is desktop. Large-text scrolling remains allowed when controls and content stay reachable.
Source thumbnails use the accepted20px-preview contract; board artwork uses its separate inherited visible-ink contract. Do not confuse the thresholds or impose a new design silently.

cases.title: Use all eight sources with Cut/Undo and earned-sorter callbacks
assertions: At390x664, select each of the eight new families through Sources. Verify the two actual controls and correct next-output preview/alt text before making.
For each family, make one real free basic piece, verify board/source art, Undo, Cut its prepared tier3 tile, and Undo to the exact prior stock/material/cursors. No new-family sorter is invented.
For the old Fern and Key callback sources, exercise earned sorter cursor positions0,1,2 using documented prepared fixtures; verify preview matches nextOutput and basic draw does not advance sorter.
Capture one screenshot for each new family pair, showing selected sources and occupied board.
Cancel and reopen Sources, Orders and one postcard; verify modal scroll/keyboard focus return, no ghost overlay, no unintended save or resumed stale action.

limits.trace: Failure only; no source/snapshot/screenshot embedding; bounded artifact size.
